tagline: Accelerating the transition to zero-emission transportation and energy
hero_kpi_rationale: Annual production capacity captures Rivian's strategic preparation for its R2 launch in 2026, with capacity doubling to 215,000 units, representing the primary lever for economic scale and unit cost reduction : critical elements for achieving profitability.

kpis.name: Vehicle Deliveries
kpis.explanation: Total number of vehicles delivered to customers during the year.
kpis.description: In 2025, Rivian delivered 42,247 vehicles (42.2K), up 20% from 2024 (35.1K), reflecting the current production pace and demand for its R1 models.

kpis.name: Annual Production Capacity
kpis.explanation: Maximum number of vehicles the factory can produce per year after upgrades.
kpis.description: Following the Normal, Illinois plant upgrades in September-October 2025, annual capacity increased from 150,000 to 215,000 units, in preparation for the R2 launch in Q2 2026.
kpis.signal: Capacity increased by 43% for R2 launch

kpis.name: R2 Model Reservations
kpis.explanation: Number of $100 deposits to reserve an R2 vehicle (refundable and cancellable).
kpis.description: Customers can reserve the R2 with a $100 deposit, fully refundable and cancellable. Over 50,000 reservations indicate strong potential demand for this model targeting broader market segments.
kpis.signal: High anticipated interest for the affordable model

kpis.name: Connectivity and Streaming Service
kpis.explanation: Subscription service for in-vehicle connectivity and audio/video streaming.
kpis.description: Connect+ was launched in 2024 as an embedded connectivity and streaming offering. It aims to create a recurring revenue stream complementary to vehicle sales, improving the margin profile.
kpis.signal: New recurring revenue stream launched in 2024

kpis.name: Onboard Autonomy Platform
kpis.explanation: End-to-end AI-based autonomous driving platform under development for future launch.
kpis.description: Autonomy+ is an advanced driver-assistance platform under development, intended to be monetized via subscription. It is built on an end-to-end AI architecture developed in-house and trained on millions of driven miles.
kpis.signal: Future AI-based premium service for recurring revenue

kpis.name: Joint Venture with Volkswagen Group Technologies
kpis.explanation: Strategic partnership to develop software platforms and zonal architectures for global markets.
kpis.description: The joint venture with Volkswagen Group Technologies aims to develop advanced software features and zonal network architectures for multiple vehicle platforms, strengthening Rivian's technological position in global markets.
kpis.signal: Access to a global ecosystem through strategic partnership

kpis.name: Vehicle Deliveries
kpis.explanation: Total number of vehicles delivered to customers during the year.
kpis.description: Deliveries increased by 20% between 2024 and 2025, rising from 35,100 to 42,247 units, despite production constraints and capacity utilization significantly below full rate.

kpis.name: Annual Production Capacity
kpis.explanation: Maximum number of vehicles the factory can produce per year after upgrades.
kpis.description: Production capacity was increased from 150,000 to 215,000 units per year in 2025, driven by upgrades to the paint shop at the Normal plant, in preparation for the R2 launch in Q2 2026.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 5 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $5.387 Bn in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 5 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of -$3.646 Bn in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

risks.title: Supplier Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on suppliers for raw materials and components, which could negatively impact operations in the event of supply disruptions or price fluctuations.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: The electric vehicle market is rapidly evolving and competition is intensifying, which could negatively affect the company's sales and market share.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: Changes in government regulation, particularly regarding electric vehicle incentives, could negatively impact the company's business.

risks.title: Production Challenges
risks.score_rationale: The company faces production challenges, particularly related to production capacity and costs, which could negatively affect its operations.

risks.title: Cost Management Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company must manage its costs to maintain profitability, particularly regarding production costs and capital expenditures.

risks.title: International Expansion Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company's international expansion may be affected by factors such as cultural differences, local regulations, and political risks.

risks.title: Reputation Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company's reputation may be affected by factors such as product quality, customer satisfaction, and stakeholder communications.

ai_positioning.summary: Rivian has no significant mentions of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar technologies in the provided excerpts from its 10-K/20-F filings. The company focuses on its automotive and software/services operations.
